title: Barley in Spring
offer: The fields are dry: time to sow! Plant barley, and while it grows, sell two crates of eggs to Orm in Hallvik to buy more seed.

steps.say: The barley is sown. Now the sun and the rain do the work.
Eggs! I make my famous egg cake. Here, good silver for good eggs.

fact: Barley was the most important grain of the north: for bread, porridge and ale.
